title: Deako Switch Event Power Draw Leaderboard
dataSources: Zigbee2MQTT device reports (`zigbee2mqtt:device`), Shelly/Tasmota telemetry (`shelly:status`, `tasmota:sensor`), Hue bridge events (`hue:event`), Nest/Ecobee thermostat (`ecobee:thermostat`), door/leak/motion sensors.
app: Philips Hue, smart plugs (Tasmota/Shelly/TP-Link Kasa), thermostats (Nest/Ecobee), locks, and Zigbee/Z-Wave sensors via MQTT / Zigbee2MQTT and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=deako:switch power_w=*
| stats sum(power_w) as total_value, avg(power_w) as avg_value by circuit_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks circuit values by total and average power draw across Deako switch event events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `power_w` values for each Deako switch event event and review total and average power draw by circuit.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total power draw.
grandmaExplanation: It will log which circuit shows the biggest power draw numbers in your Deako switch event data.
